instruction: What time is it in Tokyo right now?
why: Relay has no clock tool. The right move is to build one (the world-clock acceptance case of docs/09), not to guess a time, propose a project, or send the question to another AI.

instruction: What time is it in Tokyo right now?

tools.name: world_clock
tools.description: The current local time, date and weekday in an IANA time zone.

why: The same question once the tool exists: Relay calls the tool it built and answers from its result; it does not build a second clock, guess, or delegate.
The active projects are in the mind's context; answering from them directly is right, and reading list_projects first is also fine. Nothing may be proposed, delegated, built or asked.

instruction: Start a new project for the garden redesign.
why: A project is a write, so the only right move is to offer it and wait. There is nothing here to look up, nothing to build and nothing to send away.

instruction: When does the Atlas beta ship?
why: The answer is already on the record, so it is read with a tool and quoted. Answering from memory of the prompt, or delegating a fact the notes hold, are both wrong.

instruction: Research how UK councils license scheduling software pilots for restaurants and summarise the constraints for Lightshift.
why: Nothing local can answer this and no tool can be built for it, so delegation is the move. Building a tool to scrape the web, or guessing the constraints, are the two ways it goes wrong.

instruction: Check the stated Atlas beta date against the stored decision.
heard: Quick correction on the date, the Atlas beta is going out on October 21 now, not the 14th.
why: The flagship check: read what is stored, reach the verdict before proposing anything (it is what tells the user this is a conflict), and offer the corrected decision as one approval.

instruction: Check the stated Atlas beta date against the stored decision.
heard: And just to confirm, the Atlas beta stays on October 14, that's locked.
why: A statement that agrees with the record changes nothing: the verdict is consistent and no proposal is made.

instruction: What did we decide about the backyard fence?
why: Local mind first: a fact that is in the notes must be read with a tool and answered locally, never sent to another AI.
